compliance.summary: The article presents GoGloby as a broad executive search firm for general C-suite and VP roles, rather than a staffing and recruiting agency focused on Data & AI Engineers. Its GoGloby entry also includes unsupported claims about location, search outcomes, client endorsements, guarantees, and the author.

llm_problems.title: Broad executive search positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Services
llm_problems.issue: The page presents GoGloby as a general executive search firm for C-suite and VP hiring, while the approved description and services focus on Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Revise GoGloby’s entry and related descriptions to reflect the approved company description and the defined recruiting and staffing services.
